name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair Davies has spent the better part of three decades working in the culinary arts, starting as a kitchen porter and working his way up through the ranks to head chef at several prestigious establishments. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, he saw an opportunity to combine his passion with his profession when a catering manager position opened up at Team Gtechniq. He believes that providing high-quality, nutritious meals is crucial for maintaining team morale and performance. 

Alistair's approach is centered on creating a positive and supportive environment within the catering team. He empowers his staff to take ownership of their roles while providing guidance and mentorship when needed. He is known for his meticulous planning, innovative menu designs, and unwavering commitment to quality. His signature dish, a locally sourced lamb stew, is a team favorite and a testament to his culinary expertise. What sets Alistair apart is his ability to anticipate the team's needs, ensuring they are always well-fed and energized, both on and off the track.

physical.description: Alistair is a stout man with a friendly face and a warm smile.

quirks: Insists on using only organic ingredients whenever possible.
Always carries a small notebook to jot down recipe ideas.
Has a habit of humming classical music while preparing food.
